messages:
Maria: Quick design question — I pushed a build with compact breadcrumbs for the rule stack. Can people skim and give quick UX nits? I want to check keyboard focus, aria announcements, and the validation toast timing.
Alex: Nice! Screenshot?
Maria: (link: https://photos.redwood/preview123) — shows collapsed breadcrumbs + left rail. Key issues I noticed: 1) Focus ring is hard to see when rule cards are compressed 2) Breadcrumb separators feel like noise 3) Toast for validation sits on top of the preview and blocks the 'simulate' button.
Diego: Agree on focus ring. Maybe increase contrast + 3px outline? Also suggest using a subtle bg change on focused card so it's not just the ring.
Jen: For screen readers, instead of "Breadcrumb: Rule group > Rule" maybe use "Location: Rules stack, item 3 of 7" — gives ordinal context.
Maria: @Jen good call. Also debating whether collapsed breadcrumbs should expand on hover or on keyboard focus. Thoughts?
Alex: Prefer expand on focus only (keyboard) and on click for mouse. Hover expansion causes layout shift during scanning.
Kevin: For the validation toast, can we make it non-modal and attach it to the bottom of the rules panel? Also add a dismiss X and auto-hide 8s.
DesignBot: deploy-preview: routing-editor-breadcrumbs-v3 is live — check /preview (build 2026-03-12T09:21Z).
Diego: Small copy thing: the toast currently says "Rule failed validation" -> change to "Rule requires action: missing match condition" and include inline link to jump to problem.
Maria: Good — also want a microcopy tweak on empty-preview state: swap "No results" to "No simulated traffic matched your rules".
Alex: Keyboard nav: when reordering via keyboard, announce "Moving rule 2 of 5" and after drop announce "Moved to position 4". Screen reader users need explicit feedback.
Jen: Accessibility nit: ensure drag handles are reachable with tab, and that pressing Space starts reordering mode, Enter drops. Also verify aria-live region announcements are polite and not interruptive.
Maria: I'll implement the focus contrast and the copy tweaks. I'll keep expansion on keyboard + click only. Will update toast placement to bottom-attached and auto-hide 8s with a 'more details' link which opens the inspector on click.
Kevin: LGTM. If you want, I'll QA on Windows High Contrast mode and VoiceOver.
Maria: Thanks all. If anything else comes up ping me. :blobheart:
